title: MSME payment rules: how fast must you pay?
summary: The time limit to pay micro and small suppliers, and what it means for you.

sections.heading: What is the rule?
paragraphs: There is a time limit to pay micro and small suppliers. The limit depends on whether there is a written agreement.
The days and the source are in the box above.

sections.heading: Why it matters if you buy
paragraphs: If you pay late, there can be an effect on your tax. The box above names the section of the Income-tax Act.
Ask your CA how it applies to your business.

sections.heading: Why it matters if you sell
paragraphs: If you are a micro or small supplier, you can use the complaint portal named above.
